description: Buying goods at a market — from confirm through optional negotiation to result
trigger_detection: purchase confirm dialog visible (Load/Max/Purchase buttons present)

steps.description: Goods loaded in basket; Purchase button is yellow and ready
steps.detection: put in bulk toggle visible; basket has items
steps.notes: Screen has 3 'Purchase' strings: top-left title (back nav), bottom-left Language Effect tile, and bottom-right yellow action button. Both y and x constraints required to isolate the action button.

steps.description: Purchase Confirmation dialog — shows purchase cost; OK confirms, Back/Cancel dismisses
steps.detection: purchase cost label visible; Load / Max quantity buttons present

steps.description: Optional 'Attempt Negotiation' dialog — appears between confirm and result for purchase.  Title is 'Attempt Negotiation'; mate speech bubble on the left narrates a discount estimate; 3 buttons stacked on the right: 'No' (neutral skip), 'Use 1 chance' (white, disappears when success-rate >= 100%), 'Use all remaining chances' (yellow primary action).
steps.detection: Attempt Negotiation dialog visible — title 'Attempt Negotiation' plus 'No' / 'Use 1 chance' / 'Use all remaining chances' buttons
steps._canonical_source_note: Button labels are sourced via recovery_button_labels_ref from dialogs/market.json:negotiation_buttons.skip — no duplication.  Path A (actions/market_actions.py:_handle_negotiation) reads market.json directly during normal trade rounds; this Path B step (driven by brain/recovery.py:advance_mandatory_flow as a recovery fallback for stuck-mid-negotiation) now reads the SAME canonical labels via ControlKB.flow_step_recovery's ref-resolver.
steps.recovery_button_labels_note: current strategy is to skip negotiation for speed/certainty (refs market.negotiation_buttons.skip).  Future improvement: when the success-rate text on the dialog is >= 100% the negotiation is guaranteed to succeed, so switching the ref to market.negotiation_buttons.use_all is free profit; that requires reading the rate first.

steps.description: Purchase result dialog — must tap OK to complete
steps.detection: Result dialog visible with OK/Close button
